input.prompt:
ONE single continuous camera move from the first frame to the last frame, blended into a single smooth curve at a perfectly constant speed, like a camera on a crane: the camera travels forward down the corridor and, at the same time and throughout the whole move, rises steadily upward and tilts gently downward, so that it ends high above and behind the seated woman looking down at her desk at a diagonal angle. The forward travel and the rise happen together from the very first frame. The camera never stops, never pauses, never changes direction and never reverses at any point in the clip.

The paper walls of the corridor slide past on both sides as parallax and open out as the camera rises above them. The bright room grows steadily in the frame until it fills it.

The woman stays seated in the same chair, in the same place, with her back fully turned to the camera the whole time. Her face is never visible at any point. She does not stand, does not turn around and does not look back. Her writing hand moves only very slightly and slowly, a small calm motion of the pen on the paper, nothing more.

The sheet of paper on the desk stays COMPLETELY BLANK for the entire clip: pure unmarked cream, with nothing written, drawn, printed or marked appearing on it at any moment. The green blocks and the furniture stay exactly where they are and only change size because the camera is approaching.

Nothing enters the frame and nothing leaves the frame. No other person appears. One single continuous take. No cuts, no camera shake, no zoom snap, no scene change. No text, no letters, no numbers and no logos appear at any point.
